description: Creates or edits a press-1 menu. The account owner needs Business. A direct person target and every queue agent also need Business.

keys.description: Press-1 choices. Sending keys replaces the menu's choices.

consumer_user_id.description: Person on this account when target is user.

digit.description: Key the caller presses, such as 1.

queue_id.description: Queue on this account when target is queue.

receptionist_id.description: AI receptionist on this account when target is ai_receptionist.

target.description: user rings a person. queue rings a queue. ai_receptionist sends the caller to an AI receptionist.

name: upsert_menu
title: Set up a phone menu
